title: Pressure–Volume Loop
description: Change preload, afterload, contractility and heart rate, and watch a live left-ventricle model redraw its PV loop and Wiggers diagram beat by beat.

title: The Nephron and Diuretics
description: Follow salt and water along a nephron, segment by segment, and see where each diuretic blocks salt reabsorption and how much water follows it out.

title: Frank–Starling and Cardiac Output
description: Why a fuller heart pumps harder, and how filling, heart rate and contraction strength add up to cardiac output.

title: Blood Pressure Regulation
description: Blood pressure as flow times resistance, and how the baroreflex keeps it steady from one moment to the next.

title: The Renin–Angiotensin–Aldosterone System
description: The hormone chain the kidney uses to raise blood pressure and hold on to salt, and the drugs that cut it at each link.

title: The Autonomic Synapse
description: How sympathetic and parasympathetic nerves talk to organs through receptors, and how drugs mimic or block that signal.

title: The Cardiac Action Potential
description: The ion currents behind each heartbeat, in pacemaker and muscle cells, and how antiarrhythmic drugs change their shape.

title: The Neuromuscular Junction
description: How a nerve signal becomes a muscle contraction, and how paralytic and reversal drugs act at the junction.

title: Oxygen and Hemoglobin
description: Why hemoglobin grabs oxygen in the lungs and lets go in the tissues, drawn as the dissociation curve, and what shifts it.

title: Ventilation, Perfusion and the Alveolus
description: How air and blood meet in the lung, and what happens to oxygen when the two are mismatched.

title: Acid–Base Balance
description: The bicarbonate buffer, the lungs and the kidneys working together to hold blood pH steady, and the four ways it goes wrong.

title: The Coagulation Cascade
description: How a clot is built, from platelet plug to fibrin mesh, and where each anticoagulant and clot-busting drug acts.

title: Insulin and Glucose
description: How insulin moves glucose out of the blood after a meal, what fails in diabetes, and how each diabetes drug helps.

title: The Thyroid Axis
description: The brain-to-thyroid feedback loop that sets the body's metabolic pace, and the drugs that replace or suppress thyroid hormone.
